reason: A more directly targets thermal-aging degradation through suppressed metal diffusion, oxidation, and dissolution, and proposes measurements that can test those mediators; its cited N–Pt/HEA evidence is still only electrochemical and does not establish exhaust stability, but it is more relevant than B’s methanol-oxidation/CO-poisoning evidence.
